note: Approved 15-category scheme applied to the catalog, now including M5Stack. M5Stack parts were classified with docs.m5stack.com section hints plus keyword rules. Form factors (Unit / Module / Hat / Atomic / Stamp / Chain) are tags only. No new categories were added.

sources.sparkfun_product_pages: Many catalog SKUs 404 (discontinued). ROB-* titles recovered from Digi-Key hosted SparkFun datasheets (191/226).
sources.m5stack_repo: https://github.com/m5stack/M5_Hardware (Products/*/Structures and Common form-factor shells; KiCad 3D STEP attached when a product folder had no 3D model). No Git LFS.
sources.m5stack_docs: https://docs.m5stack.com/en/products (section paths: core, unit, module, hat, atom, stamp, accessory, base, app, chain, ...)

judgment_calls: Primary category is by function, not form. A BME280 breakout is センサー; an OLED FeatherWing is ディスプレイ; a motor shield is モーター. Form (breakout / FeatherWing / Shield / HAT / Bonnet / STEMMA / Qwiic) is a secondary tag so you can still filter by platform.
GPS/GNSS follows Adafruit (under Sensors), not SparkFun's standalone GPS category; a 通信 tag is also applied when the name mentions GPS.

SparkFun ROB-* are almost all Actobotics structural parts (shafts, tubes, wheels, bearing mounts). They get ロボット機構. Recovered datasheet titles that say Gearmotor go to モーター. The 35 ROB SKUs without a datasheet stay in ロボット機構 by prefix.
microSD / memory breakouts are filed under 通信 / インタフェース (data interface), not a separate storage category (too few to stand alone).
LilyPad / Flora / Gemma main boards are マイコンボード with a wearable tag, not the wearable category.
Relays are treated as actuators (モーター / アクチュエータ).
ADC/DAC and level shifters are 通信 / インタフェース.
RTC / clock breakouts are センサー.

M5Stack: official repo m5stack/M5_Hardware (MIT, no Git LFS). Included 269 Products folders with 3D, plus 2 products that only had KiCad STEP (Stamp UWB, Stamp Timer Power2), plus 6 Common form-factor shells with STEP+JPG. Excluded 6 folders with only PCB/2D (Faces Kit, Atom Hub Proto, Module Bus, Stamp-P4, Stamp-C5, Common/Module13.2). No new categories. Unit Puzzle (8x8 WS2812) → LED. Module LLM and StamPLC-class controllers → マイコンボード. Relays / H-bridge → モーター. GPS → センサー (same as Adafruit/SparkFun). 0 M5Stack parts in その他.
